textTool.title: Text shape
textTool.pickHint: Pick a text in the object list or the 3D view to change it, or add one: on the selected object, or as an object of its own when nothing is selected.
textTool.noComputerFonts: The browser didn't share this computer's fonts.
textTool.fontTip: Built-in fonts, a font file you load (kept in this browser), or this computer's fonts in Chrome or Edge on a computer
textTool.computerFontsOnly: This computer's fonts: Chrome or Edge on a computer only
textTool.missingFont: This text was made with a font that isn't on this device. Pick a font to change the text.
textTool.depthCutTip: How deep the text cuts in
textTool.depthTip: How far the text stands out
textTool.useSurfaceTip: The text bends with the object's surface instead of standing flat on it
textTool.perLetterTip: Each letter sits on the surface on its own, so text can go around a curved object
textTool.skewTip: Slant the letters (0.2 is a light italic)
textTool.letterGapTip: Extra space between letters, in font units
textTool.lineGapTip: Extra space between lines, in font units
textTool.undoHint: Undo brings the last text back.
textTool.leftTip: Left: lines line up on the left
textTool.centreTip: Centre: lines line up on the middle
textTool.rightTip: Right: lines line up on the right
textTool.topTip: Top: the text sits above its point
textTool.middleTip: Middle: the text sits across its point
textTool.bottomTip: Bottom: the text sits below its point
